documentation.content: 每日 dbt 檢查（source freshness / test）失敗。到 Cloud Run → Jobs → dbt-daily-checks 打開這次執行的 log，往上找 ERROR / FAIL 看是哪個 source 或 test。處理方式見 orchestration/README.md。

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name = "dbt-daily-checks" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result = "failed"
